title: In 0.7 a call of a function is of the class of what the function returns: the text of a confidential row the function reads itself, handed to a model that may see public data only, is refused (as in 0.6 since 2026-11-18, E0220i; before 0.6 the call is of its arguments' class alone; a mutation: the model is handed n instead of t).
